args: const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const fail = (message) => { process.stderr.write('[ado-mcp] ' + message + '\n'); process.exit(1); }; const required = ['AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_METHOD', 'AZURE_DEVOPS_DEFAULT_PROJECT', 'AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL', 'AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT']; for (const name of required) { if (!process.env[name] || !process.env[name].trim()) fail('missing required environment variable: ' + name); } const auth = process.env.AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_METHOD.trim().toLowerCase(); if (auth !== 'pat') fail('AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_METHOD must be pat'); let parsed; try { parsed = new URL(process.env.AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL.trim()); } catch { fail('AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL is invalid'); } let org; if (parsed.hostname.toLowerCase() === 'dev.azure.com') { org = parsed.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)[0]; } else if (parsed.hostname.toLowerCase().endsWith('.visualstudio.com')) { org = parsed.hostname.split('.')[0]; } if (!org) fail('could not derive the Azure DevOps organization'); const encodedPat = Buffer.from('mcp:' + process.env.AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT).toString('base64'); const childEnv = { ...process.env, PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN: encodedPat, ado_mcp_project: process.env.AZURE_DEVOPS_DEFAULT_PROJECT.trim() }; const result = spawnSync('mcp-server-azuredevops', [org, '--authentication', 'pat'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: childEnv }); if (result.error) fail('failed to start server: ' + result.error.message); process.exit(result.status === null ? 1 : result.status);
